body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure all our core repos have auto release non pre release.' New release job in ci.yml, gated on push to main, attaches the built plugin jar, auto-bumps MINOR version only, real (non-prerelease) GitHub release -- real versioned-rollback value even though this plugin is deployed by manual cp into EINHORN_SURVIVAL/server/plugins/, not downloaded by end users. GTA7 7a01b53.

⚓ ☃
title: Auto-release CI, matching PITVIPER's pattern
